description:
Your heart works all day without a break, so why does flexing your bicep burn? Cyto breaks it down from the 6ix, riding the #BicepHeart trend.

According to a 2024 review in Circulation Research, mitochondria (the cell's power plants) make up about one third of the volume of a heart muscle cell. The heart is built for nonstop work; your bicep is built for work in bursts. That is a design difference, not a fitness verdict.

The trend itself is just a pose: flex one arm and press the other hand on the inside of the bicep so it makes a heart shape. No health claim, just a good excuse to talk about muscle.

Not medical advice. Chest pain or an unusual heartbeat? Talk to your doctor or call emergency services.
